solves.reasoning: (A) widespread fits 'confusion among consumers', (B) healthy fits 'which foods are healthy and sustainable', (C) hinder fits 'gaps hinder implementation'. Answer: widespread-healthy-hinder = ④
(A) confusion fits 'found widespread confusion', (B) negative fits 'often negative reactions', (C) emerging fits 'emerging technologies'. Answer: confusion-negative-emerging = ①

(A) sustainable fits 'healthy and sustainable', (B) suspicions fits 'suspicions of genetically modified foods', (C) implementation fits 'successful implementation'. Answer: sustainable-suspicions-implementation = ③
① investigating=OK(were investigating), ② sort=OK(asked to sort), ③ facilitate is wrong: gaps should hinder not facilitate, ④ sustainable=OK. Answer: ③
① valued=OK(valued meat), ② combining is wrong: should be dividing(ended up dividing foods into groups), ③ alternatives=OK, ④ benefits=OK. Answer: ②
① confusion=OK, ② grouped=OK, ③ typical=OK, ④ favorable is wrong: should be negative(often negative reactions). Answer: ④
'we found widespread ____ among consumers' → confusion fits. reaction/suspicion/implementation don't fit 'widespread ___ among consumers about which foods'. Answer: ③ confusion
'plant-based milks and meat ____' → alternatives fits. consumers/participants/benefits don't fit after 'meat'. Answer: ④ alternatives
'genetically ____ foods' → modified fits. cultured/sustainable/typical don't collocate with 'genetically'. Answer: ① modified
investigating = examining (both mean researching/looking into). consuming/promoting/ignoring are unrelated. Answer: ② examining
hinder = impede (both mean to obstruct/prevent progress). accelerate/sustain/achieve are different meanings. Answer: ③ impede
widespread = prevalent (both mean occurring widely). occasional/deliberate/temporary are unrelated or opposite. Answer: ④ prevalent
similar ↔ distinct. likely/typical/negative are on different semantic axes. Answer: ① distinct
successful ↔ futile. gradual/modified/cultured are on different axes. Answer: ② futile
(A) sort by date = arrange in order = 정렬하다. (B) sort foods into groups = classify/categorize = 분류하다. Answer: ④ 정렬하다-분류하다
'the process of putting a plan or system into effect' = implementation. investigation=research, confusion=bewilderment, suspicion=doubt. Answer: ③ implementation
These gaps(plural subject) + present tense = base form hinder (not hinders for singular). Answer: hinder
____ modified foods needs adverb to modify past participle. genetic(adj) → genetically(adv). Answer: genetically
'they didn't consider them as part of ____' → 'any typical food group' fits the context of not belonging to standard food categories. Answer: ② any typical food group
'products that could have ____' → 'environmental and health benefits' fits. The other options describe problems or technologies, not benefits. Answer: ① environmental and health benefits
